To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a combination of pricing/admission control strategy can be used to ensure fairness and increase the revenue of the Web service, (ii) a dynamic price can be determined using a heuristic that takes into account the revenue enhancement for the server and the fairness for the clients, (iii) an admission control strategy based on a dynamic price can also be used to ensure a level of fairness and increase revenue for the server.
(i) a dynamic pricing structure is needed for Web services, and (ii), a simple heuristic that is easy to implement and has a low computational complexity can be used to set the price.

1) a combination of pricing/admission control strategy is necessary for a Web service provider to maximize revenue, 2) the revenue can be increased by dynamically modulating the parameters in this combination, and 3) this modulation is best done by a heuristic that takes into consideration the factors such as revenue enhancement, implementability and computational overhead.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of pricing and admission-control strategies that are fair to the clients and the servers and also maximize revenue.
a dynamic pricing and admission control scheme for Web servers.
a dynamic pricing and autonomic control strategy for commercial services on the Web.

the heuristics that we have developed for dynamically modulating pricing and admission control for a commercial Web service can be used for a large class of Web services.
the pricing and admission-control strategy that we have developed and the heuristics that we have developed for tuning it are very promising.
the heuristics developed in this paper are simple, effective and implementable.

we have developed a novel pricing/admission control strategy that takes into consideration the widely time varying nature of loads, and we have developed and evaluated three heuristics to dynamically tune the parameters of the pricing/admission control scheme to maximize revenue.
we have developed and analyzed a novel combination of pricing and control strategies that are fair and that can maximize revenue.

we have developed and evaluated a dynamic pricing and admission control mechanism that takes into consideration time-varying requests, fairness to both clients and server, and the need to maximize revenue.

the pricing strategy and the admission control mechanism should be designed in tandem.
